segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וּבַמָּה אֵינָהּ יוֹצְאָה? — לֹא יֵצֵא גָּמָל בִּמְטוּלְטֶלֶת, לֹא עָקוּד וְלֹא רָגוּל, וְכֵן שְׁאָר כׇּל הַבְּהֵמוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And with what may» an animal «not go out» into the public domain on Shabbat? «A camel may not go out with a saddlecloth, nor» may it go out «akud or ragul», which are different ways of tying its legs together, as will be explained in the Gemara. «And likewise,» tying «all other animals» in those manners is prohibited.

segments.he: לֹא יִקְשׁוֹר גְּמַלִּים זֶה בָּזֶה וְיִמְשׁוֹךְ, אֲבָל מַכְנִיס חֲבָלִים לְתוֹךְ יָדוֹ וְיִמְשׁוֹךְ, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁלֹּא יִכְרוֹךְ.
segments.en: And likewise, «one may not tie camels one to the other and pull» the lead camel, thereby pulling the others after it. «However, he» may «place the ropes» tied to each of the camels «in his hand and pull» them all, «provided that he does not intertwine» the ropes.

moves.summary: camel may not go out with a saddlecloth, akud or ragul
no tying camels together and pulling
but may hold the ropes in hand without intertwining
